name: marquee
description: Self-hosted media metadata dashboard - TMDb + Plex/Jellyfin + Sonarr/Radarr. Look up any actor, studio, or franchise, see instantly whether it's already in your Plex or Jellyfin library, being downloaded, or coming soon, and send anything missing straight to Sonarr or Radarr. Built for households: the admin account (created on first visit) connects Plex and/or Jellyfin plus Sonarr/Radarr, and can add accounts for everyone else. Other household members get the full app - Discover, Search, My Library, Favorites, Calendar - but request titles instead of adding them directly, so nothing downloads without the admin's approval. Includes a release calendar, download notifications, and a mobile-friendly UI. This is a single, self-contained container - Postgres runs inside it, there is nothing else to install. Just set a POSTGRES_PASSWORD below and go. First visit after install creates the one-time admin account. Full setup instructions: https://github.com/TimmyAmant/marquee#readme

paths.name: Postgres Data
paths.description: Where Marquee's built-in Postgres database is stored

variables.name: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
variables.description: Password for Marquee's built-in database. Pick any strong password - just remember it, it's not used anywhere outside this container.

variables.name: AUTH_SECRET
variables.description: Any long random string. Generate with: openssl rand -base64 32

variables.name: MASTER_ENCRYPTION_KEY
variables.description: Base64 32-byte key used to encrypt saved Sonarr/Radarr/Plex/Jellyfin credentials. Generate with: openssl rand -base64 32 -- BACK THIS UP, losing it makes saved credentials undecryptable.

variables.name: AUTH_TRUST_HOST
variables.description: Leave as true for LAN access without a fixed domain

variables.name: POSTGRES_USER
variables.description: Built-in database username - the default is fine for almost everyone

variables.name: POSTGRES_DB
variables.description: Built-in database name - the default is fine for almost everyone

variables.name: TMDB_API_KEY
variables.description: From themoviedb.org/settings/api. Can also be set later from within the app: Settings -> Integrations.

variables.name: TMDB_ACCESS_TOKEN
variables.description: Alternative to TMDB_API_KEY (TMDb v4 access token) - only need one of the two

variables.name: TVDB_API_KEY
variables.description: From thetvdb.com/api-information - used to cross-reference Sonarr's shows to TMDb
